crossRefs.note: Rest in Yahweh, and wait patiently for him. Don’t fret because of him who prospers in his way, because of the man who…
Her rival provoked her severely, to irritate her, because Yahweh had shut up her womb.
The foolishness of man subverts his way; his heart rages against Yahweh.
Don’t be envious of evil men, neither desire to be with them;
Don’t fret yourself because of evildoers, neither be envious of the wicked;
For I was envious of the arrogant, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
Don’t envy the man of violence. Choose none of his ways.
Don’t let your heart envy sinners, but rather fear Yahweh all day long.
envy, murders, drunkenness, orgies, and things like these; of which I forewarn you, even as I also forewarned you, that…
Or do you think that the Scripture says in vain, “The Spirit who lives in us yearns jealously”?
But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”

parallels.note: Don’t fret yourself because of evildoers, neither be envious of the wicked;

translations.web: Don’t fret because of evildoers, neither be envious against those who work unrighteousness.
translations.bsb: Do not fret over those who do evil; do not envy those who do wrong.
translations.kjv: Fret not thyself because of evildoers, neither be thou envious against the workers of iniquity.
translations.asv: Fret not thyself because of evil-doers, Neither be thou envious against them that work unrighteousness.
